description: This bar chart, titled “Accuracy (%)” on the left y-axis and “Token Count” on the right y-axis, displays two metrics for three models—CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—across two distinct sets of bars. The horizontal axis contains the model labels, with each model represented by two bars: one for Accuracy (%) and one for Token Count, arranged in pairs. The left y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, and the right y-axis, labeled “Token Count”, ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. The chart uses a color-coded legend at the bottom to associate each model with its respective bar colors: CoD is represented by red and orange bars, CCoT by light blue and orange bars, and CoUT by green and light green bars. For each model, the first bar (in red, light blue, or green) corresponds to the Accuracy (%) value, while the second bar (in orange, orange, or light green) corresponds to the Token Count. The specific values are labeled directly on top of each bar: for CoD, the accuracy is 91.19% (red bar) and token count is 80.89 (orange bar); for CCoT, the accuracy is 88.50% (light blue bar) and token count is 534.24 (orange bar); for CoUT, the accuracy is 88.40% (green bar) and token count is 354.46 (light green bar). The chart does not show any sorting of bars by value, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and labeled values.
